component.name: Apache SpamAssassin
component.description: Anti-spam email filtering platform. The referenced document is the project's security policy: it describes how to report vulnerabilities (security /at/ spamassassin.apache.org, or Bugzilla with the restricted Security component) and the security team's internal handling workflow (verification, CVE requests, discreet commit practices, release and announcement), following the ASF vulnerability handling process. It documents no threats, assets, or trust boundaries.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it.
